summary.text: Brian Seitz is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House District 156 since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Seitz is a pastor and business owner from Branson who served in the U.S. Army.

paragraphs.text: Brian Seitz was born in Michigan and lives in Branson, Missouri.
He served in the U.S. Army from 1983 to 1986 and earned a bachelor's degree from Missouri State University in 1990.
His career experience includes working as pastor of Sovereign Grace Baptist Church, manager of Splash Carwash, and owner of Music Country News.
Seitz took office on January 6, 2021, succeeding Jeff Justus.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him on the Commerce Committee.
